ffi_impossibility_triangles.name: The Zero-Copy Memory Triangle
vertices: Zero-copy direct memory sharing (raw pointers/slices across language or host/device boundaries)
Moving/compacting garbage collection or independent non-coherent reclamation
Deadlock-free, handle-free isolation without pinning stalls or cross-heap reference-cycle leaks
ffi_impossibility_triangles.incompatible_triple: A foreign runtime cannot simultaneously dereference unpinned raw pointers into a moving/non-coherent heap without risking dangling addresses, pinning-induced GC/DMA stalls (GCLocker, runtime.Pinner), or unreclaimable cross-heap reference cycles.
ffi_impossibility_triangles.formal_mechanism: Memory-ownership and relocation invariants require either (a) copying/marshaling value ownership across disjoint heaps (Canonical ABI, FIDL), (b) capability/handle indirection with explicit epoch/scope pinning (HPy, Panama FFM, OCaml shadow roots, CHERI/IOMMU), or (c) a unified cross-component collector/heap.

system_resolutions.Wasm Component Model (WIT Canonical ABI): Drops zero-copy raw sharing for shared-nothing copies + opaque resource handles.
system_resolutions.GraalVM Truffle: Drops independent collectors for a unified JVM heap and polyglot InteropLibrary.
system_resolutions.Java Panama FFM / HPy / Go Pinner: Trades zero-overhead raw pointers for scoped handles, explicit pinning, or memory segments.
system_resolutions.CHERI / Mill Portals / Linear DMA+IOMMU: Hardware-enforces spatial capability bounds and explicit transfer/revocation to reduce boundary cost to cycles.

ffi_impossibility_triangles.name: The Stack & Control-Flow Triangle
vertices: Arbitrary synchronous re-entrant cross-language calls (A -> B -> A)
Movable/segmented green-thread stacks, stackless async state machines, or multi-shot delimited continuations
Zero-overhead native C ABI unwinding (.eh_frame/SEH), linear RAII destructors, and async-signal safety
ffi_impossibility_triangles.incompatible_triple: Native C frames assume contiguous pinned stacks, process-global signal tables, and linear return/unwind trajectories, conflicting directly with stack relocation (Go), fiber/continuation capture or cloning (OCaml 5, multi-shot effect handlers), and synchronous-drop async cancellation.
ffi_impossibility_triangles.formal_mechanism: Crossing non-isomorphic control-flow disciplines requires stack switching (Go cgo g0 stack), forbidding continuation capture across foreign frames (OCaml 5 C-call boundary), explicit unwind-table contracts (C-unwind + matched personality routines), or effect/signal virtualization.

system_resolutions.Go cgo: Switches from movable goroutine stack to pinned OS thread stack with scheduler handoff tax.
system_resolutions.OCaml 5: Restricts algebraic effects to single-shot fibers and forbids performing effects across C FFI frames.
system_resolutions.Koka / Effekt: Compiles tail-resumptive effects via evidence passing / capability passing, isolating linear resources statically.
system_resolutions.Rust C-unwind / Swift typed throws: Constrains unwinding at ABI boundaries or replaces DWARF table unwinding with explicit error returns.

ffi_impossibility_triangles.name: The Performance vs. Full-Abstraction & Isolation Triangle
vertices: Native cross-boundary throughput (cross-language inlining, unboxed aggregates, register passing)
Sound gradual/contract enforcement with complete monitoring and blame (or full-abstraction/hyperproperty preservation)
Fine-grained modular isolation across untrusted or polyglot components
ffi_impossibility_triangles.incompatible_triple: Enforcing higher-order behavioral contracts or full abstraction across untrusted/polyglot seams imposes dynamic proxy/chaperone overhead (10x-100x Takikawa cliffs) or sandbox crossing costs, whereas aggressive cross-language optimization (ThinLTO, shared-heap JIT) erases aliasing/provenance and isolation boundaries.
ffi_impossibility_triangles.formal_mechanism: Boundary enforcement trades asymptotic wrapper depth (space-efficient coercions/threesomes vs. transient checks) against optimization opacity; hardware capabilities (CHERI/Mill) shrink the isolation constant factor but cannot eliminate contract-checking work for expressive dynamic predicates.

system_resolutions.Typed Racket / Collapsible Contracts: Prioritizes complete monitoring + blame, mitigating (not eliminating) proxy cliffs via contract collapse.
system_resolutions.Reticulated Python (Transient) / Nom (Co: Sacrifices higher-order blame or structural flexibility to remove proxy cliffs.
system_resolutions.GraalVM Truffle / Cross-Language ThinLTO: Prioritizes native peak speed by collapsing memory isolation or merging IR semantics.
system_resolutions.CHERI / Wasm Components / Mill Portals: Prioritizes spatial/component isolation with hardware or sandboxing bounds rather than full higher-order behavioral contracts.

ffi_impossibility_triangles.name: The Semantic Unity vs. Verification Diversity Triangle
vertices: Heterogeneous best-in-class verification paradigms (step-indexed separation logic, SMT/VCGen, abstract interpretation, translation validation)
Open decentralized compositional linking without whole-program re-verification (DimSum, CompCertO, Linking Types)
Preservation of 2-safety hyperproperties and cross-crate reuse across non-invertible compilation codecs under a minimal TCB
ffi_impossibility_triangles.incompatible_triple: Step-indexed logics cross boundaries cleanly only at closed-program adequacy; forgetful compilation codecs erase source facts needed by callers; 1-safety trace refinement fails to preserve 2-safety hyperproperties (constant-time, non-interference); and heterogeneous provers differ in axiom bases and dual-nondeterminism polarity.
ffi_impossibility_triangles.formal_mechanism: Sound heterogeneous composition requires a common semantic spine (e.g., trace/ITree/event-module refinement or Goguen-Burstall institutions), explicit polarity alignment, paired source+target ShardCert export to bypass codec non-invertibility, and relational/leakage-contract extensions for 2-safety.

system_resolutions.DimSum (POPL 2023): Achieves decentralized multi-language refinement via dual-nondeterminism module wrappers, focusing on 1-safety trace inclusion.
system_resolutions.Melocoton (OOPSLA 2023): Achieves expressive Iris separation-logic proofs for OCaml<->C FFI, closing the step-indexed logic at adequacy.
system_resolutions.CompCertO / CCR / ITrees: Provides open-module operational semantics and simulation conventions for C/assembly composition.
system_resolutions.Anneal Paired Contract + Leakage Refinem: Combines representation-invariant BehaviorCodecs, paired source+target contracts, and relational/leakage models under a minimal kernel audit boundary.

open_research_problems.title: Machine-Checkable Cross-Language ABI Specifications Replacing Prose psABIs
open_research_problems.statement: Replace prose psABI manuals (SysV AMD64, AAPCS64, Win64) with an executable, formally specified, target-parameterized ABI descriptor shared across compilers and verifiers.
open_research_problems.why_open: Existing compilers (rustc, Clang, GCC, Cranelift) each maintain bespoke heuristic classifiers that silently disagree on u128, f128, HFAs, bit-fields, and ZSTs, while LLVM IR lacks target-independent ABI types.
open_research_problems.falsification_or_progress_trigger: Adoption of a shared executable ABI specification (e.g., abi-cafe-verified formal spec) consumed directly by both LLVM/Clang and rustc codegen backends with zero differential mismatches.

open_research_problems.title: Capability-Safe Typed Dynamic Linking Without Flat String Namespaces
open_research_problems.statement: Design a verified dynamic loader and binary module format supporting separate compilation, ABI resilience, and safe unloading without ELF flat symbol interposition or untyped C constructor graphs.
open_research_problems.why_open: Verified static linkers exist only for narrow ELF subsets (CompCertELF, Linksem), while real ecosystems rely on unverified ld.so/dyld/PE loaders with global interposition, TLS models, and unsafe dlclose.
open_research_problems.falsification_or_progress_trigger: A mechanized dynamic-loader specification and verifier covering relocations, two-level typed imports, TLS, and safe module unloading on ELF/Mach-O or Wasm Components.

open_research_problems.title: Unbundled Capability OS Primitives Replacing fork(), Signals, and Flat Virtual Memory
open_research_problems.statement: Standardize an OS process/I/O boundary that unbundles process creation, asynchronous notifications, completion-based I/O, and memory reservation so multiple language runtimes can coexist safely in one address space.
open_research_problems.why_open: POSIX.1-2024 retains process-global signal tables and fork() assumptions that break multi-threaded GCs and async runtimes; Capsicum, Zircon, io_uring, and WASI remain fragmented across kernels.
open_research_problems.falsification_or_progress_trigger: Standardized multi-runtime-safe OS notification/reservation interfaces deployed across Linux/BSD/Windows or WASI Preview 3+.

open_research_problems.title: Content-Addressed Live/Image Systems With Zero-Cost Native Polyglot Interop
open_research_problems.statement: Combine hash-identified AST/code stores and live schema migration (Smalltalk, Unison) with deterministic AOT native compilation and verified zero-copy foreign interfaces.
open_research_problems.why_open: Image-based and content-addressed environments struggle to reconcile live structural identity and dynamic object migration with static native ABIs, external build reproducibility, and low-level memory layouts.
open_research_problems.falsification_or_progress_trigger: A production content-addressed language compiling directly to verified native/component ABI artifacts with live schema-evolution proofs.

open_research_problems.title: Pause-Free Hardware Temporal Safety and Cross-Domain DMA Revocation
open_research_problems.statement: Eliminate sweeping-revocation pause/barrier tails in capability architectures (CHERI Cornucopia Reloaded, CHERIoT) and extend capability revocation uniformly across IOMMU/DMA and CXL devices.
open_research_problems.why_open: Spatial capability bounds fit in 128-bit registers, but temporal safety requires revoking aliased copies in memory and device descriptor rings without prohibitive memory bandwidth or quarantine bloat.
open_research_problems.falsification_or_progress_trigger: Silicon evaluation demonstrating deterministic sub-microsecond temporal revocation across CPU + DMA/CXL endpoints with <5% memory and throughput overhead.

open_research_problems.title: Predictable Surface Elaboration Across Subtyping, Polymorphism, and Dependent Types
open_research_problems.statement: Design decidable, principal-type-preserving elaboration boundaries that combine subtyping, higher-rank polymorphism, GADTs, and quantitative dependent erasure without hitting undecidability cliffs.
open_research_problems.why_open: F_<: subtyping (Pierce 1994), Java wildcard subtyping (Grigore 2017), and higher-order unification are undecidable; practical compilers rely on fragile heuristics (OutsideIn(X), Scala 3 DOT approximations) with opaque failure modes.
open_research_problems.falsification_or_progress_trigger: A mechanized elaboration calculus unifying algebraic subtyping (MLsub) with GADTs/dependent erasure that guarantees termination, completeness over a crisp surface fragment, and small-core certificates.

open_research_problems.title: Resolving the Global Coherence vs. Separate Modularity vs. Sound Specialization Trilemma
open_research_problems.statement: Support modular, locally scoped type-class/trait abstractions and sound performance specialization without breaking global data-structure invariants (e.g., Ord/Hash map coherence) or erasing lifetime soundness.
open_research_problems.why_open: Global orphan rules block modular composition; local implicits risk dictionary incoherence across merged collections; and lifetime-erased specialization enables unsound type transmutation.
open_research_problems.falsification_or_progress_trigger: Stabilization of a mechanized sound specialization + scoped-coherence system (such as verified min_specialization or 1ML-style coherent implicits) in a mainstream systems compiler.

open_research_problems.title: Safe Composition of Multi-Shot Effect Handlers, Linear Resources, and Foreign Stack Frames
open_research_problems.statement: Synthesize a graded effect-and-capability type system and compilation strategy that permits zero-cost tail-resumptive handlers, linear resource safety under multi-shot continuations, and sound traversal across foreign FFI frames.
open_research_problems.why_open: Cloning a continuation duplicates linear handles unless statically fenced by graded shot counts/coeffects, while existing runtimes (OCaml 5) drop multi-shot continuations and forbid effects across C frames.
open_research_problems.falsification_or_progress_trigger: A native-compiled language with mechanized soundness proving graded multi-shot effects + linear resources + FFI stack-boundary safety with <10% overhead on tail-resumptive code.

open_research_problems.title: Unifying Operational Pointer Aliasing (Tree Borrows / PCG) With Weak-Memory Concurrency and Must-Linearity
open_research_problems.statement: Define a modular operational memory model unifying dynamic aliasing protectors (Tree Borrows), flow-sensitive borrow graphs (Polonius/PCG), must-linear unwind obligations, and relaxed atomic concurrency (RC11/Promising).
open_research_problems.why_open: Stacked Borrows and Tree Borrows have incomparable acceptance sets, dynamic FnEntry protectors complicate modular reborrow-returning contracts, and neither composes yet with relaxed weak-memory atomics.
open_research_problems.falsification_or_progress_trigger: A mechanized concurrent Tree Borrows + weak-memory operational model with verified modular function-frame rules and compiler optimization adequacy.

open_research_problems.title: Eliminating 2^N Gradual-Typing Blame Cliffs and Enabling Typed Post-Resolution Reflection
open_research_problems.statement: Collapse higher-order gradual-typing proxy overhead without sacrificing complete monitoring, and replace untyped token-stream macros with hygienic, post-resolution typed reflection over canonical layouts and DefIds.
open_research_problems.why_open: Collapsible contracts mitigate pathological chains yet still face 2^N migration cliffs on real lattices; meanwhile systems languages lack incremental, deterministic, post-resolution reflection hooks that preserve soundness across attribute ordering.
open_research_problems.falsification_or_progress_trigger: Empirical demonstration of <2x worst-case slowdown across the full Takikawa GTP benchmark lattice with complete monitoring, and a typed post-resolution reflection system eliminating token-re-parsing derive bugs.

open_research_problems.title: Verified Multi-Level IRs Without Semantic-Erasure Cliffs Across Regions and E-Graphs
open_research_problems.statement: Construct a multi-level compiler IR combining structured regions (RVSDG/MLIR), acyclic e-graphs (aegraphs), and explicit poison/provenance/effect traits so optimizations and lowerings remain formally verifiable end to end.
open_research_problems.why_open: V8's retreat from Sea-of-Nodes to Turboshaft exposed scheduling fragility; MLIR dialect traits are mostly unchecked prose; and e-graphs struggle with stateful control flow and aliasing side conditions.
open_research_problems.falsification_or_progress_trigger: A formally verified multi-level IR compiler achieving LLVM -O2 parity while checking dialect-lowering and e-graph rewrite certificates inside a proof kernel.

open_research_problems.title: Decidable Polymorphic Layout Algebras and Reference-Admissible ABI Resilience
open_research_problems.statement: Formalize a decidable compile-time layout constraint algebra (size, alignment, padding, niche occupancy, affine-ceiling DST metadata inversion) usable across both monomorphized and ABI-resilient witness-table generics.
open_research_problems.why_open: Nested packed/aligned DSTs yield non-injective size-to-metadata plateaus; missing generic const-layout predicates force unsafe post-monomorphization errors (PMEs) and brittle const assertions.
open_research_problems.falsification_or_progress_trigger: A statically checked polymorphic layout algebra integrated into a systems compiler typechecker eliminating PMEs and verifying metadata-inversion injectivity.

open_research_problems.title: Mechanized Soundness for Tiered Speculative JITs, Partial Escape Analysis, and OSR
open_research_problems.statement: Scale mechanized JIT verification (CoreJIT, FM-JIT) to concurrent multi-tier pipelines with inline caches, global protector assumptions, partial escape analysis / virtual-object materialization, and OSR entry.
open_research_problems.why_open: Production JITs (V8, HotSpot C2, Graal) mutate assumptions concurrently across threads and synthesize complex heap graphs at deoptimization points, far beyond current sequential Coq JIT models.
open_research_problems.falsification_or_progress_trigger: A mechanized simulation proof covering concurrent assumption invalidation, virtual-object rematerialization, and OSR frame migration for a bytecode-to-native JIT.

open_research_problems.title: Mechanized Verification of Concurrent Moving GCs, Statepoints, and Weak-Memory Barriers
open_research_problems.statement: Verify end-to-end soundness across both compiler stack-map/safepoint insertion (including derived interior pointers and loop strip mining) and concurrent moving GC load/write barriers on weak-memory hardware.
open_research_problems.why_open: Existing mechanized GC proofs isolate simplified sequential or non-moving collectors, whereas real production bugs sit at the seam between LLVM optimizations, derived pointers, FFI roots, and relaxed memory ordering.
open_research_problems.falsification_or_progress_trigger: An end-to-end verified compiler + concurrent compacting collector (MMTk/ZGC-class) mechanized under ARMv8/RC11 weak memory with verified derived-pointer relocation.

open_research_problems.title: Sound AsyncDrop, Cancel-Safe Structured Concurrency, and Fair Work-Stealing Progress
open_research_problems.statement: Establish type-checked cancel safety and asynchronous resource cleanup (AsyncDrop) alongside mechanized liveness/fairness proofs for work-stealing schedulers under cooperative budgets and blocking FFI calls.
open_research_problems.why_open: Dropping a suspended state machine synchronously leaks in-flight I/O or invariants; adding AsyncDrop interacts deeply with unwinding, select! racing, and linear types; LIFO slots and FFI blocking threaten progress.
open_research_problems.falsification_or_progress_trigger: A statically checked AsyncDrop/cancellation discipline with mechanized cancel-safety and starvation-freedom proofs for a work-stealing runtime.

open_research_problems.title: Cycle-Free, Deadlock-Free Multi-Runtime Memory Interop Across Independent Collectors
open_research_problems.statement: Characterize the minimal runtime protocol (handles, epoch pinning, cross-heap weak references, or capability ownership) that prevents cross-heap memory leaks and safepoint deadlocks between co-resident managed and native runtimes.
open_research_problems.why_open: Independent tracing collectors cannot collect reference cycles spanning heap boundaries without either a cross-runtime tracing protocol, linear ownership restrictions, or memory-copying encapsulation.
open_research_problems.falsification_or_progress_trigger: A formal cross-heap ownership/tracing protocol proven deadlock-free and cycle-reclaiming across two distinct moving collectors (e.g., JVM + OCaml 5 or WasmGC + Rust).

open_research_problems.title: Multicore, Effect-Aware Multi-Language Program Logics Unifying DimSum, Melocoton, and Linking Types
open_research_problems.statement: Extend decentralized multi-language semantics (DimSum) and FFI separation logics (Melocoton) to multicore weak-memory concurrency, re-entrant callbacks with effects/exceptions, and aligned dual-nondeterminism polarities.
open_research_problems.why_open: Melocoton models single-domain OCaml<->C without multicore data races or algebraic effects; DimSum and Melocoton use opposite angelic/demonic boundary polarities; and Linking Types assume realizable shared targets.
open_research_problems.falsification_or_progress_trigger: A mechanized Coq/Lean framework combining DimSum-style decentralized horizontal composition with multicore Iris/Melocoton separation-logic FFI proofs.

open_research_problems.title: Semantically Sound Polyglot Whole-Program Optimization Without Isolation Collapse
open_research_problems.statement: Enable cross-language inlining and unboxing across polyglot components (Rust+C ThinLTO, Wasm Components, GraalVM Truffle) while preserving distinct source provenance, aliasing, unwinding, and security isolation boundaries.
open_research_problems.why_open: Current linker-plugin LTO fuses incompatible Rust noalias/noundef and C TBAA attributes into unsound LLVM IR, while shared-nothing Wasm Component boundaries pay copy taxes unless WasmGC/shared-everything threads weaken isolation.
open_research_problems.falsification_or_progress_trigger: A formally verified polyglot optimizer preserving multi-language provenance/aliasing tags across cross-language inlining with mechanized soundness.

open_research_problems.title: Open-World Cross-Logic Verification Composition Under Non-Invertible Compilation Codecs
open_research_problems.statement: Compose separately verified modules proven in distinct logics (Iris, Verus/SMT, CompCertO, abstract interpretation, translation validation) across FFI seams without whole-program re-verification or trusted cross-logic axioms.
open_research_problems.why_open: Forgetful compilation codecs prevent inverting target theorems back to source contracts; step-indexed logics lose modularity across adequacy boundaries; and provers rely on incompatible foundational axioms.
open_research_problems.falsification_or_progress_trigger: An end-to-end machine-checked multi-language binary combining at least three distinct verification paradigms via paired source+target contracts audited by one small proof kernel.

open_research_problems.title: Compositional Preservation of 2-Safety Hyperproperties Across Multi-Language Refinement
open_research_problems.statement: Preserve relational 2-safety hyperproperties (cryptographic constant-time, speculative non-interference, secret erasure, probabilistic independence) across separate compilation, cross-language FFI, and heterogeneous verification bridges.
open_research_problems.why_open: Standard 1-safety trace refinement (Beh_tgt <= Beh_src) is strictly blind to 2-safety hyperproperties; resolving nondeterminism in a secret-dependent way or eliminating dead zeroize() stores satisfies 1-safety while leaking secrets.
open_research_problems.falsification_or_progress_trigger: A compositional multi-language refinement theorem preserving constant-time and speculative leakage contracts across mixed verified/unverified FFI boundaries.

open_research_problems.title: Semantic SemVer, Proof-Aware Version Solving, and Hermetic Polyglot Supply Chains
open_research_problems.statement: Replace syntactic SemVer and language-siloed package managers with automated API/ABI/specification-compatibility checking, predictable dependency resolution, and content-addressed hermetic polyglot build graphs.
open_research_problems.why_open: Dependency solving is NP-complete in general; syntactic SemVer fails on trait coherence, auto traits, ABI drift, and spec strengthening; and multi-language verification toolchains break under mtime and ambient-linker assumptions.
open_research_problems.falsification_or_progress_trigger: A polyglot package/build manager that verifies behavioral/ABI compatibility signatures across upgrades and caches cross-language proof artifacts content-addressedly.

open_research_problems.title: High-Precision Type, Borrow, and SMT Failure Localization Under Resilient Live Parsing
open_research_problems.statement: Deliver human-interpretable, causally accurate blame localization across unification/trait inference, borrow-checker permission provenance, and SMT verification failures inside live incremental IDEs.
open_research_problems.why_open: Minimum unsatisfiable subset (MUS) / MaxSMT localization scales poorly on large constraint graphs; backward VCG obscures forward execution causes; and elaboration-dependent syntax breaks incremental parsing.
open_research_problems.falsification_or_progress_trigger: Controlled empirical studies and sub-100ms IDE deployment showing combined MUS/bidirectional type localization + giant-step validated SMT counterexamples cutting debugging time >2x.

open_research_problems.title: Unified Machine-to-Source State Relations for Verified Debuginfo, Time-Travel Replay, and Polyglot Async Stacks
open_research_problems.statement: Unify DWARF debuginfo, JIT deoptimization FrameStates, GC stack maps, and compiler simulation invariants into one checked state relation supporting deterministic time-travel debugging across optimized, async, and polyglot stacks.
open_research_problems.why_open: Optimizations routinely drop or corrupt variable locations (Hennessy currency problem); deterministic replay (rr) requires hardware PMU support and single-core serialization; and mixed Python/Rust/JVM/async frames lack unified causal unwinding.
open_research_problems.falsification_or_progress_trigger: A compiler pass pipeline that emits formally checked debug-location witnesses verified by simulation invariants and consumed by a cross-language async/time-travel debugger.

open_research_problems.title: Eliminating SMT Solver Instability and Superlinear Proof Maintenance Costs
open_research_problems.statement: Achieve predictable, perturbation-invariant automated verification and low-cost proof maintenance across evolving codebases through context pruning, quantifier discipline, untrusted functional lifting, and automated proof repair.
open_research_problems.why_open: Mariposa demonstrated widespread SMT instability under trivial renamings/reseedings; E-matching loops cause timeouts; deductive proof ratios scale superlinearly (2x-40x+); and small spec/AST edits break large proof suites.
open_research_problems.falsification_or_progress_trigger: Production verification benchmarks exhibiting <1% Mariposa instability under seed/order perturbations alongside automated proof-repair survival >90% across real upstream releases.

open_research_problems.title: Adversarial Goodhart-Resistant Specifications and Memory-Safe Million-Step Proof Kernels
open_research_problems.statement: Design proof-assistant kernels with call-by-value/packed-array reducers, strictly opaque memory-safe interface wire formats, automated semantic mutation testing, and formal contracts hardened against adversarial/AI reward hacking.
open_research_problems.why_open: Current dependent-type kernels suffer call-by-name WHNF cliffs, accidental theorem unfolding, and memory-unsafe binary deserializers (.olean/.vo); positive verification suites miss nearly 100% of TCB guard-weakening mutants; and naive contracts fall to miracle targets or observation erasure.
open_research_problems.falsification_or_progress_trigger: A memory-safe, opaque-interface proof kernel verifying million-step compiler derivations in milliseconds paired with 100%-mutant-killing TCB semantics suites and mechanized anti-Goodhart contract checks.

open_research_problems.title: Unified Verified Compilation Across Non-Von-Neumann CPUs, Spatial CGRAs, BSP Tiles, and Reversible Substrates
open_research_problems.statement: Design a clean-slate multi-level IR and verified backend architecture capable of targeting temporal-SSA belts (Mill), block-atomic dataflow (EDGE), spatial CGRAs, wafer-scale/BSP/NoC tiles (Cerebras, Graphcore, Tensix, Groq), PIM, and reversible ISAs without fighting flat-register Von Neumann assumptions.
open_research_problems.why_open: LLVM hardcodes flat mutable registers, coherent caches, and unstructured scalar CFGs; every non-Von-Neumann engine must bypass or fight mainstream compiler middle-ends.
open_research_problems.falsification_or_progress_trigger: One formally verified structured-dataflow compiler targeting both a conventional CPU and at least two non-coherent spatial/BSP/belt architectures from shared algorithmic IR.

open_research_problems.title: Verified Tensor Layout/Swizzle Algebras, Async Scratchpad Pipelines, and Safe Scoped-Memory GPU Programming
open_research_problems.statement: Mechanize hybrid (Z x F_2) tensor layout/XOR-swizzle algebras, asynchronous TMA/DMA/mbarrier phase-parity pipelines, and borrow-checked scoped-memory ownership (Descend) inside verified user-schedulable accelerator compilers (Exo/Halide/Triton/Mosaic).
open_research_problems.why_open: Hopper/Blackwell async memory proxies, TMEM warp specialization, non-transitive PTX/Vulkan scopes, and bank-conflict-free swizzles are currently verified ad hoc or only in C++ template metaprogramming.
open_research_problems.falsification_or_progress_trigger: A mechanized Lean/Coq library proving CuTe-class layout bijectivity, 32-bank conflict freedom, mbarrier deadlock freedom, and scoped-DRF for generated GPU/TPU kernels at CUTLASS/Mosaic peak throughput.

open_research_problems.title: Sound Compilation and Verification for Post-IEEE-754 Numerics, Non-Differentiable AD, and Measure-Zero PPLs
open_research_problems.statement: Provide sound compiler semantics and verification for block-scaled/narrow ML numerics (OCP MXFP, FP8 E4M3FN, IEEE P3109, stochastic rounding), piecewise non-differentiable reverse-mode AD, and dynamic-support/measure-zero probabilistic inference.
open_research_problems.why_open: Block-coupled shared exponents break per-element aliasing/mutability; E4M3FN lacks infinity; AD across conditional branches fails classical chain rules at measure-zero kink sets; and general continuous symbolic disintegration is undecidable.
open_research_problems.falsification_or_progress_trigger: Formally verified compiler passes for IEEE P3109/MXFP numerics, mechanized Clarke-subdifferential/diffeology AD soundness for LLVM/MLIR, and verified support-checked SVI/HMC inference compilers.

open_research_problems.title: End-to-End Verified Software-Hardware FFI Across Typed HDLs, Interconnects, DMA, IRQs, and FPGA DPR
open_research_problems.statement: Unify typed hardware languages (Koika, Filament, Calyx, CIRCT, ACT) with verified systems software across a single mechanized SW<->HW FFI covering MMIO, AXI4/TileLink/ESI interconnects, RoCC coprocessors, linear cache-incoherent DMA/IOMMU/CXL, preemptive IRQs, RTL<=TLM refinement, and FPGA DPR.
open_research_problems.why_open: IEEE 1800 SystemVerilog suffers X-optimism and simulation/synthesis divergence; Bedrock2+Kami and Pancake cover narrow embedded MMIO but not modern cache-incoherent DMA, CXL, out-of-order interconnects, or live partial reconfiguration.
open_research_problems.falsification_or_progress_trigger: A full-stack silicon-tested SW+HW proof linking a verified OS driver and typed HDL accelerator across AXI4/DMA/IRQ and DPR boundaries under one proof kernel.

open_research_problems.title: Decidable Verification Frontiers for Fixpoints, Async MPST, WCET, Under-Constrained ZK, and Quantum Uncomputation
open_research_problems.statement: Bridge practical expressiveness and decidable verification across non-monotone relational/e-graph fixpoints (egglog/DBSP), asynchronous multiparty choreographies under crash failures, timing-anomaly-free WCET, deterministic ZK constraint completeness, and entanglement-safe quantum uncomputation.
open_research_problems.why_open: Async MPST subtyping is undecidable; unstratified lattices diverge without widening; OoO microarchitectures exhibit unbounded timing domino effects; proving R1CS/PLONK uniqueness is co-NP/undecidable in general; and quantum uncomputation fails silently when auxiliary qubits remain entangled.
open_research_problems.falsification_or_progress_trigger: Verified compiler-enforced decidable fragments delivering automated uniqueness proofs for production ZK circuits, cost-preserving WCET on pipelined silicon, and fault-tolerant choreographic EPP.
